original: 何か嫌な予感がすると思った瞬間、突然目の前が真っ暗になった。

en.text: At the moment that I thought I was having a premonition, suddenly everything went black.

original: 目の前の仕事に精神を集中させなさい。

en.text: Concentrate your attention on the job in front of you.

original: 目の前の、あの大きい建物は何なの？

en.text: What is that big building in front of us?
